headline: LSEG Finance Prices Tender Offer for $1.25 Billion in Notes
summary: LSEG Finance plc has announced the pricing for its tender offer to repurchase outstanding 2.500% notes due in 2031. The offer targets a total principal amount of $1.25 billion.
why: This is a standard capital management operation by a subsidiary of the London Stock Exchange Group to manage its debt maturity profile.

impacts.name: London Stock Exchange Group
impacts.why: The tender offer is a routine debt management activity.
